Being part of MAC means being a core piece of a continuously growing, dynamic community that moves together for a better life. Here, ideas are valued, teammanship is deeply supported, and feeling good is just as important as working efficiently. If you want to be a part of our well-being community and shape the future of the fitness experience through data technologies, we would love to hear from you! Qualifications & Experience We Are Looking For • Education: Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields. • Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in data engineering, with a proven track record in developing and managing data pipelines and data warehouses. • Database & ETL: Strong experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) and Oracle databases (SQL, PL/SQL). Hands-on expertise in analyzing, developing, and optimizing complex ETL processes. • Core Languages & Platforms: Advanced SQL and strong Python skills. Experience with at least one modern analytical data platform such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Apache Doris . • Cloud Infrastructure: Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)—specifically BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub . • Data Modeling: Proficiency in data modeling, dimensional modeling, star schema, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD). • Orchestration & Transformation: Experience with workflow management and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Dataform . • Integration: Proven experience in integrating data from disparate systems using API and CDC (Change Data Capture) methods. • Data Quality & CI/CD: Knowledge of data quality frameworks, testing, monitoring, and CI/CD pipeline implementation. • AI/ML Support: Experience with data pipelines, training datasets, and infrastructure supporting machine learning models. • BI & Documentation: Ability to build reliable, well-documented datasets to support Power BI reporting. • Cost Optimization: Knowledge of optimizing storage, processing, and query costs in cloud environments. • Communication & Mindset: • Strong communication skills in both English and Turkish. • Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities. • Ability to translate complex technical concepts and options into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders. • Collaborative approach and strong team player mindset. What Will You Be Doing? • Analyze and optimize our existing Oracle/ODI-based data warehouse and actively contribute to modernizing our data architecture. • Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines for incoming data across membership, CRM, finance, mobile, web, and marketing platforms. • Leverage GCP tools ( BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI ) to build data infrastructures supporting reporting, analytics, machine learning, and AI initiatives. • Design, build, and optimize both batch and incremental data processing pipelines. • Develop robust data models and data marts that allow business units to track key performance indicators (KPIs) consistently. • Collaborate closely with Data Science and AI Engineering teams to prepare data sets and pipelines required for AI and machine learning applications. • Establish data infrastructure for model development, training, deployment, and monitoring. • Enhance platform reliability by implementing automated data quality, testing, and monitoring workflows. • Prepare clean, accessible, and well-documented data layers for self-service Power BI reporting. • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party tech partners to ensure technical standards, control deliverables, and retain core domain knowledge in-house. • Ensure high performance, scalability, and cost optimization as data volume grows. • Contribute to architectural and technical decision-making to keep the infrastructure aligned with evolving business needs. • Continuously follow emerging trends in data engineering and cloud technologies to elevate MAC’s data ecosystem. Nice-to-Haves • Experience in data warehouse modernization or legacy migration projects. • Hands-on experience with MLOps processes (Feature Store, Vertex AI Pipelines, model deployment, and monitoring). • Experience with streaming or real-time data processing. • Proficiency in Power BI or SSAS Tabular. • Knowledge of GA4, event-based product analytics, and customer engagement platforms. • Prior experience in high-data-volume sectors such as tech, retail, consumer products, or fitness/wellness.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer - Market Data
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer – Market Data based in Netherlands. Join an innovative technology environment transforming how institutions access and understand blockchain and financial market data. In this senior individual contributor role, you will design and build a next-generation market data platform delivering reliable, real-time feeds and historical datasets to institutional customers. You will take technical ownership of distributed systems responsible for ingesting, processing, normalising, storing, and delivering high-quality data across multiple sources. Working at the intersection of backend engineering, streaming infrastructure, and financial data, you will help shape critical architectural decisions around performance, correctness, reliability, and scalability. You will also mentor engineers, influence technical direction across teams, and drive continuous improvements to production systems. In a remote-first, international engineering team, you will have the autonomy to solve complex challenges and use AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery while maintaining exceptional engineering standards. Accountabilities Design, develop, and operate distributed backend systems for ingesting, normalising, processing, storing, and delivering real-time market data from blockchain networks and other relevant financial data sources. Build and maintain robust streaming infrastructure that handles event ordering, timestamps, duplicate records, replay, missing data, and recovery, including blockchain reorganisations and transaction finality where relevant. Develop reliable client-facing data feeds and APIs with clearly defined delivery guarantees, evolving schemas, appropriate access controls, and predictable performance under heavy workloads or when consumers fall behind. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to define and improve reference data models, historical data capture, and the integration of new data sources and capabilities. Establish and continuously improve service-level objectives (SLOs) and data quality metrics, monitoring latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness across the platform. Independently investigate production issues, conduct thorough root cause analyses, and implement durable fixes that improve system resilience, recovery, and operational efficiency. Own services throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, production support, and participation in the team's on-call rotation. Integrate AI-assisted development tools throughout the engineering workflow, using them to explore architectural options, implement changes, generate tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation while maintaining strong technical oversight. Develop repeatable AI-assisted engineering practices, share effective workflows with colleagues, and contribute to continuous improvements in development productivity and quality. Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, document architectural proposals clearly, and help translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production-ready solutions. Mentor engineers through implementation, code reviews, and technical discussions, enabling the team to deliver complex projects with high standards of reliability and maintainability. Requirements Extensive experience building and operating distributed backend systems or data services with demanding reliability, scalability, and performance requirements, including the ability to diagnose failures across service and data boundaries. Strong expertise in real-time streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, event processing, and recovery mechanisms. A deep understanding of data correctness and integrity, including timestamp handling, numerical precision, schema evolution, data corrections, event ordering, and consistency across distributed systems. Strong computer science fundamentals and advanced backend engineering skills, with experience in languages such as Rust, Go, or comparable programming languages. Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous technical and business requirements into clear architectural designs, deliverable work, and robust production services. Experience taking end-to-end ownership of software systems, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and ongoing operational improvements. Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to influence architectural decisions across teams, mentor other engineers, and guide implementation without relying solely on formal management authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document complex technical concepts and collaborate effectively with colleagues in a distributed, remote-first environment. Experience working with financial or market data at a financial institution or in a comparable data-intensive environment is valuable. Familiarity with blockchain data and indexing, including EVM-compatible networks or Solana, is a plus. Experience with reference data systems, including instrument and entity master data, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, tokenised assets, or fund data, is advantageous. Experience working at a company where data is the core product is also beneficial. A strong sense of ownership, sound engineering judgement, and a proactive approach to using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity without compromising reliability or quality. Benefits Competitive salary and equity: A compensation package designed to be highly competitive within the industry, with both salary and equity positioned among the top 25% of comparable companies. Employee-friendly equity terms: An employee equity scheme offering a heavily discounted exercise price, approximately 90% below the standard reference price, and a 10-year exercise window. Generous paid time off: Five weeks of annual leave, in addition to local public holidays, which can be adjusted to suit your needs. Fully remote working: Work remotely within a distributed international team, with flexible hours and the freedom to organise your own working day. Flexible collaboration: A healthy balance of asynchronous and synchronous communication, with an emphasis on focused work and minimising unnecessary meetings. Comprehensive healthcare: Private medical insurance, dental coverage, and vision care as standard benefits. Paid parental leave: 16 weeks of fully paid leave for primary caregivers and six weeks for secondary caregivers, plus a two-week phased return to work on a part-time schedule at full pay. Quarterly company and team offsites: Opportunities to meet colleagues in person, collaborate, and build relationships at gatherings in exciting locations. Annual travel allowance: Funding to travel and work alongside colleagues or teams for several days each year. Home office support: An allowance to create a comfortable and productive home-working environment, or company-paid access to a local coworking desk. Professional growth: Work alongside talented engineers on technically challenging projects that shape the future of blockchain and financial data infrastructure. Inclusive culture: Join a team committed to diversity, inclusion, and creating an environment where people with different backgrounds and perspectives can thrive. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Backend-Developer (m/w/d) - Telematikinfrastruktur (TI)
review_candidates.description: Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen! Technologie. Sicherheit. Verantwortung. Du möchtest moderne Backend-Systeme entwickeln und gleichzeitig die Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens vorantreiben? Bei der apo.com Group arbeitest du an unseren Apothekenplattformen und deren Anbindung an die Telematikinfrastruktur (TI). Als Backend Developer (m/w/d) – Telematikinfrastruktur entwickelst du zuverlässige Schnittstellen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme sicher und reibungslos miteinander kommunizieren. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für technische Lösungen rund um das E-Rezept und weitere digitale Gesundheitsanwendungen. Ob an unserem Standort bei Leipzig oder zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands – du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwicklungs- und IT-Teams sowie weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen. Deine Aufgaben bei uns Entwickeln. Integrieren. Optimieren. Backend-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst und betreust unsere Backend-Systeme auf Basis von PHP oder Kotlin und arbeitest mit Datenbanken wie MySQL. Schnittstellen entwickeln: Du konzipierst, implementierst und dokumentierst REST-APIs unter Verwendung von OpenAPI. Telematikinfrastruktur integrieren: Du entwickelst unsere Anbindungen an die TI weiter, insbesondere im Bereich E-Rezept und KIM (Kommunikation im Medizinwesen). E-Rezept-Anbindung: Du integrierst unseren Kotlin-basierten E-Rezept-Client, der FHIR-basierte Funktionen kapselt und über Schnittstellen bereitstellt. Technische Anforderungen umsetzen: Du analysierst komplexe Spezifikationen und entwickelst daraus zuverlässige, wartbare und testbare Lösungen. Systemintegration: Du verbindest interne Anwendungen mit externen Partnern und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Datenaustausch. Fehleranalyse & Optimierung: Du identifizierst technische Probleme, behebst Fehler und stellst die Stabilität unserer produktiven Systeme sicher. Technische Verantwortung: Du betreust eigenständig TI-relevante Themen, behältst technische Abhängigkeiten im Blick und koordinierst notwendige Anpassungen. Zusammenarbeit: Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partnern ab und begleitest die Umsetzung neuer Anforderungen. Das bringst du mit Technisches Know-how. Analytisches Denken. Eigeninitiative. Programmierkenntnisse: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in PHP oder Kotlin. Kenntnisse in Laravel sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Softwarearchitektur: Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von objektorientierter Programmierung (OOP), Softwarearchitektur und bewährten Entwurfsmustern (Design Patterns). Schnittstellenkompetenz: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit REST-APIs und kannst technische Spezifikationen verstehen und in funktionierende Anwendungen übersetzen. Bestehende Systeme: Du hast Erfahrung mit gewachsenen Softwarestrukturen und entwickelst vorhandenen Code sinnvoll weiter. FHIR-Verständnis: Du kannst FHIR-basierte Spezifikationen lesen und verstehen. Eigene Implementierungserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich. KI-Affinität: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools und Coding Agents, um Entwicklungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und dich schnell in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und behältst auch bei komplexen Themen den Überblick. Qualitätsbewusstsein: Sicherheit, Datenschutz, die Einhaltung regulatorischer Vorgaben und die Nachvollziehbarkeit technischer Lösungen sind für dich selbstverständlich. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1), um regulatorische Anforderungen und technische Spezifikationen sicher zu verstehen. Für die Zusammenarbeit in unserem internationalen Team bringst du zudem sehr gute Englischkenntnisse mit. Zusatzkenntnisse: Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit der Telematikinfrastruktur (z. B. E-Rezept, KIM, ePA), FHIR/HL7, gematik-Spezifikationen, Apothekenprozessen oder zertifikatsbasierter Authentifizierung mit. Auch Kenntnisse im Betrieb und in der Überwachung produktiver Systeme sind ein Plus. Wichtig: Du musst noch kein Experte für die Telematikinfrastruktur sein. Entscheidend sind dein technisches Verständnis, deine Bereitschaft, dich in komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten, und deine Motivation, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln. Das bieten wir dir Safety First: Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag Work Location: Markkleeberg bei Leipzig, 0-100% Remote Work, ganz deinem Wunsch entsprechend 9 to 5 Job?: Nein! Du kannst dir deine Arbeit flexibel einteilen Gute Arbeit zahlt sich aus: Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung Happy Holiday: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr Es gibt immer etwas zu lernen: Schulungen, Workshops und Side-By-Side-Coaching, wir unterstützen dich bei deiner Weiterentwicklung Fit durch die Freizeit: JobRad-Kooperation Weitere Benefits: Sehr gute Sozialleistungen u.a. mit eigener, subventionierter Kantine, Corporate Benefits, kostenfreier Getränkeversorgung (Tee, Kaffee, Softgetränke), Personalrabatte, moderner Ausrüstung, Team- und Firmenevents u.v.m. Wir freuen uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung, in der du uns auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und dein mögliches Eintrittsdatum mitteilst. Über uns Die apo.com Group ist eine der führenden Online-Apothekengruppen im deutschen Markt mit vier Standorten in Europa. Wir stehen für Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit gepaart mit einer ausgeprägten Leidenschaft für intelligente Technologien und Digitalisierung. Dafür setzen wir auf pharmazeutische Kompetenz, innovative digitale Services und KI gestützte Logistik Technologie. Wir unterstützen Menschen dabei, gesund zu werden und gesund zu bleiben.
